'''Zarrak's hang glider''' was a specially designed [[Hang-glider/Legends|hang glider]] used by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Zarrak]], a user of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark magics]]. Zarrak's glider was much larger and more elaborate in appearance than other Ewok hang gliders.

==Characteristics==
This hang glider was dark in color and had a tail hanging off the end of it. A band could snap over Zarrak's head and across his stomach, allowing him to lean into it and guide its flight path. Zarrak could [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] draw the glider to himself.

==History==
[[File:Zarrak_hang_glider.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Zarrak in his glider]]

After being exiled from [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], Zarrak kept this hang glider within [[Zarrak's mountain|his mountain]]. After consulting the [[prophecy pool]] and being told that the Ewok [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] was powerful enough to defeat him, Zarrak called his hang glider to him to depart his mountain and head to Bright Tree Village to meet with Teebo.
